question: What does the single unnamed boolean in WM_Killshot (imported by the six site Sniper Rifles) enable, and does it bear on any displayed weapon number?
sourceFacts: WM_Killshot (raw sha256 049f729947b006a8543597cb5094a1a2b9e0b557faa077bb31c2c3ed3900491b): Field_8d6d2bc1 = true, raw bool 01 at offset 216 (re-read with scripts/frosty-raw-check.py); every other leaf neutral; imported by interdictor, l115, m2010esr, miniscout, psr and sv98 (L109).
Ability_Killshot and U_Ability_Killshot are an ability-category entry and its selector (c9ac1d21-bc55-48ae-a825-90f3b15d6817); neither carries an effect payload or text.
The English strings table has the label "Killshot" (7F1B63AA); no captured raw asset references that StringId.
Related names elsewhere: animation parameter Animations/Common/MM.KillshotKilled.Bool (catalog only) and the soldier registry KillshotSuppressionResistance 0.25 (bounds 0.1/0.5, L109).
inference: By name only, Killshot concerns kill feedback (animation or suppression state) rather than a weapon stat. No operand, text or consumer supports any effect on cadence, recoil or spread.
unresolved: What the boolean enables at runtime; whether it links to KillshotSuppressionResistance or MM.KillshotKilled.Bool.
siteImpact: None. No displayed number changes and no enhancement proposal follows.
